entities.summary: Rio Noble Ruiz is an American professional baseball third baseman for the Diablos Rojos del México of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Atlanta Braves, Baltimore Orioles, and Colorado Rockies, and in the KBO League for the LG Twins. He was selected in the fourth round of the 2012 Major League Baseball draft by the Houston Astros. In 2015, Ruiz was traded to the Atlanta, with whom he made his major league debut during the 2016 season.
